summary.title: Concurrent commit to the same inode can report success for both writers
summary.observed: When two clients commit new versions of the same file at nearly the same time, both receive a success response and one version is silently lost.
summary.expected: Exactly one commit succeeds; the other receives a version conflict and can retry.
summary.trigger: Two writers commit to one file within a short window, after both have read the same prior version.
